shortcuts.toggle-right-panel: show or hide the right panel
shortcuts.new-browser-tab: open a new browser tab in the panel
shortcuts.toggle-left-sidebar: show or hide the left sidebar
shortcuts.close-tab-or-window: close the browser tab, or the window
shortcuts.newline: start a new line instead of sending

feature.memory: Doing a lot of work? Ask Atlarix to remember the key things, so the next session picks up where you left off.
feature.sessionRecall: Ask about something from earlier in this chat — it can search the transcript, even after compacting.
feature.previousSession: Ask Atlarix to read a previous session by name when you want accurate context on earlier work.
feature.autocomplete: Type / for commands, or @ to point at a file.
feature.mcp: Connect MCP servers in Settings → Integrations to give Atlarix your own tools.
feature.skills: Drop a markdown file in .atlarix/skills/ to teach Atlarix a repeatable job — or ask it to write one.
feature.voice: Dictate instead of typing — Whisper runs on your machine, so it needs no key.
feature.automations: Put recurring work on a schedule with automations.
feature.subagents: Hand independent work to sub-agents and let them run in parallel.
